query:
EVALUATE
ROW(
  "OpenByCurrentMeasure", [_Open_Incidents],
  "TrulyActive Neu/InProgress/Wait", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(IncidentsAllFields[incidentid]), IncidentsAllFields[statuscodename] IN {"Neu","In Progress","In Wartezustand"}),
  "CanceledCountedOpen", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(IncidentsAllFields[incidentid]), IncidentsAllFields[statuscodename] IN {"Abgesagt","Vom Kunden storniert"}),
  "MergedCountedOpen", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(IncidentsAllFields[incidentid]), IncidentsAllFields[statuscodename] = "Zusammengeführt"),
  "OpenNoFirstResponse", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(IncidentsAllFields[incidentid]), NOT IncidentsAllFields[statuscodename] IN {"Behoben","Abgeschlossen","Closed"}, IncidentsAllFields[firstresponsesent] = FALSE()),
  "ActiveNoFirstResponse", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(IncidentsAllFields[incidentid]), IncidentsAllFields[statuscodename] IN {"Neu","In Progress","In Wartezustand"}, IncidentsAllFields[firstresponsesent] = FALSE()),
  "OpenMissingSlaDate", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(IncidentsAllFields[incidentid]), NOT IncidentsAllFields[statuscodename] IN {"Behoben","Abgeschlossen","Closed"}, ISBLANK(IncidentsAllFields[resolveby])),
  "ActiveMissingSlaDate", CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(IncidentsAllFields[incidentid]), IncidentsAllFields[statuscodename] IN {"Neu","In Progress","In Wartezustand"}, ISBLANK(IncidentsAllFields[resolveby]))
)
